_note: Asset (character) config. Lives at the asset path (e.g. {asset_work}/cfx_asset.json) and is reused by every shot. Authored once per character.
_proxy_parts_note: authored interactively via the Proxy HDA 'Cloth Parts' multiparm; geo_path is selected from the REST_MESH geo_path values (verified live: Pants_geo, Polo_shirts_geo, Belt_geo, Gloves_geo, Shoses_geo, ...). proxy_path defaults to *{name}*. Each part carries its OWN vellum constraint params in 'parameters' (stretch_stiffness/bend_stiffness/thickness/mass/pin_group); missing keys fall back to the top-level 'constraint' block. Hair parts (cloth:false) get a vellum 'hair' constraint and pin their root group (FirstPoints) by default.

parameters._pin_note: pin_group is a REST-pose point group expression (or a painted group name); it is materialized at rest and rides through the per-frame deform so the pinned waistband follows the body. Example pins the waistband by rest height.
